map.查询各类职业/语言/IT证书信息: Look up occupational / language / IT certificate information.
map.真伪初筛：输入证书编号或关键信息，核对格式与基础字段: First-pass authenticity screening: enter the certificate number or key details to check the format and basic fields.
map.应聘背调：对候选人提供的证书做初步一致性检查: Hiring background checks: run a preliminary consistency check on the certificates a candidate submits.
map.自我核对：确认证书名称、颁发机构与有效期无误: Self-checking: confirm that the certificate name, issuing body and validity period are correct.
map.例：输入证书编号与持证人姓名，工具核对编号规则、颁发机构字段是否齐全；若编号位数: Example: enter the certificate number and the holder's name, and the tool checks whether the numbering rules are met and whether the issuing-body field is complete; if the number of digits is wrong or the issuer name looks abnormal, it prompts you to verify further through official channels rather than relying on this page alone.
map.本工具仅做字段与格式层面的初步核验，不能替代人社部、学信网等官方查询；涉及录用、: This tool only performs a first-pass check at the field and format level and cannot replace official queries such as those of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security or CHSI; for hiring or qualification decisions the official system result always prevails.
map.查不到一定假吗？: Does failing to find it mean the certificate is fake?
map.不一定，可能是编号录入有误、证书类型不在覆盖范围内，或官方数据未同步；建议核对输: Not necessarily: the number may have been entered incorrectly, the certificate type may not be covered, or official data may not yet be synchronized. Check your input and confirm again on the issuer's official website.
